title: Annotation Gist embed attempts to load remote JavaScript in the extension
surface: Guidance screenshot annotation editor and Chrome Web Store package
auth_mode: member/admin; package-level policy risk independent of sign-in
preconditions: Use the current tldraw 4.5.12 dependency consumed by the annotation editor.
Open a guidance screenshot annotation or restore a saved annotation containing a Gist embed.
reproduction: Inspect the installed Gist renderer in tldraw/dist-esm/lib/shapes/embed/EmbedShapeUtil.mjs.
Render or paste a GitHub Gist URL and observe iframe srcDoc containing a script URL under gist.github.com ending in .js.
Observe the iframe has no sandbox attribute, so the isolated-frame exception to Chrome's remotely hosted code policy does not apply.
expected: Annotation editing remains usable, while Gist embeds do not attempt to load remotely hosted executable code in the extension and the exact Store ZIP passes policy review.
actual: The installed tldraw Gist renderer emits a remote script inside an unsandboxed srcDoc iframe. Extension CSP may block execution at runtime, but the packaged code still attempts a forbidden load. This path was found during the Blue Argon rejection audit; Google did not identify it in the rejection email.
severity: S2: Gist embeds may not render and create a policy risk for a replacement Store submission; ordinary annotation tools remain available
priority: P0: remove the remote executable path before the next Store submission
next_action: Verify the exact hosted Store ZIP contains no Gist remote-script renderer, then retest paste and saved-annotation restore in the signed-in browser before closure. The source fix passed independent review and the exact-source development artifact scan, but neither is product acceptance or Store approval.

transition_history.reason: Source audit found a second remote-script path while investigating the Store's Blue Argon rejection.
The installed renderer, extension reachability and unsandboxed srcDoc boundary were independently inspected.
A focused replacement is implemented; independent review found a remaining test-claim gap.

The bounded source repair passed fresh peer review and exact-source CI; all emitted development JavaScript was scanned with zero Gist srcDoc remote-script matches. Store ZIP and live annotation retest remain open.
